title: Luscious Thai Lamb Kebabs
description: A nostalgic Thai dish featuring lamb loin chops, mushimono-steam, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, with a fatty and cheese-pull twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, grated ginger, and Thai red curry paste.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the kebabs are grilling, steam the mozzarella cheese in a mushimono-steam basket for 2-3 minutes, or until melted and stretchy.
Serve the kebabs hot, topped with the steamed mozzarella cheese and garnished with fresh cilantro.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with steamed vegetables or rice for a complete meal.
